name: atom-200-974
rationale: Gas-phase partner of the bounded CO2 200/974 quadrature check. The earlier200/1454 attempt aborted before SCF because the pinned Lebedev implementation supports at most974 points; retain that attempt and never restart it. Use the accepted original CPU WFN, not the aborted attempt. Retain binary, basis, geometry, dispersion, cutoff and nonperiodic analytic Poisson setup. Assess only the matched lattice-energy difference once both phases are accepted.
